content: TASK_REQUEST taskvault-mvp: Build TaskVault MVP (see typed payload for acceptance criteria).

payload.goal: Build TaskVault: a small Python CLI app with persistent local JSON storage supporting add/list/complete commands, input validation and error handling, automated tests, and README documentation. One design decision (storage format/location) must be documented.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: add/list/complete CLI commands work end-to-end (argparse entry point taskvault)
AC2: tasks persist in local JSON storage across invocations
AC3: invalid input (empty title, unknown id) yields clear error messages and non-zero exit
AC4: at least 6 automated tests cover add/list/complete/validation/persistence
AC5: README documents install, usage, storage design decision, and how to run tests
AC6: code split across multiple source files (cli, store, models at minimum)
AC7: canonical ForgeLoop task taskvault-mvp exists and workflow followed (no manual .forgeloop edits)
